turns.content:
Now I understand the issue. There's a corrupted configuration file `/etc/ld.so.conf.d/99-corruption.conf` that adds `/tmp/fake_libs` to the library search path, and there are fake/broken library files there (`libxml2.so.2` and `libxslt.so.1`). These fake libraries are being picked up by the dynamic linker before the real ones, causing the symbol resolution issue.
